zh: 广告主把推广任务放在 Moonetix 广告墙上：试用一个应用、看一段演示、注册一个试用账号。 完成一项，广告主付钱，我们按约定比例折成乘法币发给你。奖励由服务商回调入账， 不是前端自己加的——所以到账会晚几十秒，也可能被冲正。

The reward is credited by the provider's server callback, not by the page itself — so it lands a few seconds late and can be reversed.

zh: 问卷由委托方发布，通过审核后在此处显示。新问卷上线时，站内消息会发出提醒。 符合样本条件的问卷才会出现在列表中，条件不符或名额已满的问卷不显示。
en: Surveys are published by research clients and appear here once approved. You get an in-site message when new ones go live. Only surveys that match your profile are listed — ones you do not qualify for, or that are full, stay hidden.

en: Nothing matches your profile right now, or this round is full. New surveys trigger an in-site message. Filling in your age range, city and occupation will widen what you match.

zh: 提现申请提交后金额进入冻结，审核通过十五个工作日内打款；兑换码类商品即时发放， 订阅类商品由人工在两个工作日内开通，结果通过站内消息通知。
en: Once a payout is requested, the amount is held until it is approved, then paid out within fifteen business days. Gift codes are issued instantly; subscriptions are activated manually within two business days, and you are notified by in-site message.

zh: 乘法币可提现至支付宝或微信，也可即时兑换数字兑换码。两条路径折算比例一致， 不存在手续费差价，选择哪一种只取决于用途。
en: XB can be withdrawn to Alipay or WeChat, or spent instantly on digital codes. Both routes use the same rate with no fee spread — which one you pick only depends on what you need.

zh: 1 乘法币折 1 元人民币、1 乘法刀折 1 美元，两者数值相同，可点导航栏余额后的币种切换；提现与兑换码采用同一比例，不额外收取手续费。
en: 1 XB = 1 CNY and 1 XD = 1 USD, same number either way. Use the currency switch next to your balance in the top bar. Withdrawals and gift codes use the same rate and carry no extra fee.

zh: 墙由第三方托管，在你的账号名下展开任务列表；同一个账号 ID 每次打开都是同一个人， 所以奖励不会串号。
en: The wall is hosted by a third party and opens under your account ID, so every visit is recognised as the same person and rewards never go to the wrong account.

zh: 广告主要先校验任务有没有真的完成，通常几十秒到几分钟。刚做完没看到余额变化，先等一会儿。
en: The advertiser verifies the task first, which usually takes from tens of seconds to a few minutes. If the balance has not moved right away, give it a moment.

zh: 如果任务被判定无效（卸载太快、资料造假），服务商会发一条冲正回调，已发的奖励会被扣回。
en: If a task is judged invalid — uninstalled too fast, fake details — the provider sends a reversal callback and the reward is taken back.

zh: 判定标准共三项：全部题目选择同一选项、作答时间显著短于正常阅读所需时间、答案与前序筛选题相互矛盾。 判定无效后将扣回该份问卷的积分并记录原因。如对判定结果有异议，可在积分明细中提交申诉，由人工复核。
en: There are three criteria: identical answers to every question, a completion time far shorter than it takes to read the survey, or answers that contradict earlier screening questions. Invalid responses have their points clawed back with the reason recorded. If you disagree, open a ticket from the ledger and a human will review it.

en: Most surveys take three to fifteen minutes, with rewards set by question count and research difficulty, usually a few CNY up to twenty. Length and reward do not always track each other — some short surveys pay more because the sample is scarce. The list shows expected time and reward for each one.

zh: 品牌方与研究机构需要真实用户的反馈，并为此支付调研费用。完成一份时长三至十五分钟的问卷即可获得相应积分。 积分累计至标准额度后可提现至支付宝或微信，亦可兑换数字兑换码。
en: Brands and research firms need feedback from real users and pay research fees for it. Finish a three-to-fifteen-minute survey and you earn points. Once you reach the threshold you can withdraw to Alipay or WeChat, or spend the points on digital codes.

zh: 积分累计至等值十元后可申请提现，转入支付宝或微信账户； 亦可直接兑换 Steam 充值卡、游戏激活码及软件会员等数字兑换码，到账速度快于现金提现。
en: Once your points reach the equivalent of 50 CNY you can request a payout to Alipay or WeChat, or spend them directly on digital codes — Steam wallet cards, game keys, software subscriptions — which arrive faster than a cash payout.

zh: 委托方会限定样本条件，包括年龄段、城市、职业或特定产品的使用频率。名额满额或条件不符时， 问卷将无法进入。该限制由调研需求决定，与账户状态无关。

zh: 使用邮箱完成注册，耗时约三十秒。填写年龄段、所在城市与职业等基础信息， 用于匹配符合条件的问卷。上述信息仅用于样本筛选，不作商业用途。

zh: 平台不设邀请码。注册完成后即可浏览全部问卷，积分于答卷审核通过后即时入账； 等级与天梯榜仅用于展示活跃度，不影响参与资格与问卷单价。
en: There is no invite code. Once registered you can browse every survey, and points are credited as soon as a response passes review. Levels and the leaderboard only show activity — they do not affect eligibility or survey prices.

zh: 积分累计至等值十元后即可提交申请。审核通过后十五个工作日内到账， 处理记录可在「积分明细」中查询。提现账户须与注册人实名信息一致。

zh: 判定标准共三项：全部题目选择同一选项、作答时间显著短于正常阅读所需时间、答案与前序筛选题相互矛盾。
en: Three criteria: the same option picked on every question, a completion time far shorter than normal reading requires, or answers that contradict the earlier screening questions.

zh: 注册和登录时使用 Cloudflare Turnstile 做真人校验。该服务会处理你的 IP 地址和浏览器信号，用于判断请求是否来自自动化程序。本站只接收「通过 / 未通过」的结论，不保存校验过程的原始数据。
en: Registration and sign-in use Cloudflare Turnstile to check that you are human. The service processes your IP address and browser signals to decide whether a request comes from an automated program. We only receive a pass or fail verdict and never store the raw verification data.

zh: 打开站内任意页面时，服务器会记一条访问日志：访问时间、页面路径、IP 地址、网络归属（国家 / 省份 / 城市、运营商与所属网络）、来源域名、浏览器标识，以及浏览器随请求一并发送的语言偏好与请求类型标识。
en: Opening any page records a visit log: the time, page path, IP address, network location (country, province, city, carrier and network), referring domain, browser identifier, plus the language preference and request-type flags the browser sends along with the request.

zh: 站内任何页面按键盘上排的数字键，直接跳到对应功能。默认按功能目录的编号走，第 10 项用 0。在输入框里打字时不会触发。1 左边那个键（` 或 ~ 都行）回账户首页，跟数字键同一套开关，键位固定不可改。
en: On any page, press a number key on the top row to jump straight to that feature. Numbers follow the directory order, with 0 for the tenth item. Typing in an input field does not trigger it. The key left of 1 (either ` or ~) returns to your account home, shares the same on/off switch, and cannot be rebound.

zh: 多数问卷耗时三至十五分钟，收益依据题目数量与调研难度确定，通常折合人民币数元至二十元。
en: Most surveys take three to fifteen minutes, and the reward depends on the number of questions and the difficulty of the study, usually a few yuan up to twenty.

zh: 品牌方与研究机构需要真实用户的反馈，并为此支付调研费用。完成一份时长三至十五分钟的问卷即可获得相应积分。
en: Brands and research firms need feedback from real users and pay for it. Completing a survey that takes three to fifteen minutes earns the corresponding points.

zh: 不需要。注册、问卷大厅、积分明细、兑换与提现均已上线，填写用户名、邮箱与密码即可开通，
en: No. Registration, the survey hall, the points ledger, redemption and payouts are all live: just fill in a username, email and password,

zh: 这页不是第三方网站，是本站照着广告墙的样子做的模拟版。点「标记完成」，
en: This page is not a third-party site. It is our own mock-up of an ad wall. Clicking 'Mark complete'

zh: 常见原因有三种：问卷按样本条件投放，资料缺项或不符合条件的账户不会匹配到；
en: There are three common reasons: studies are targeted by sample criteria, so accounts with missing or ineligible details never match;

zh: 问卷由委托方发布，通过审核后在此处显示。新问卷上线时，站内消息会发出提醒。
en: Surveys are published by clients and appear here once approved. We send an in-site message when new surveys go live.

zh: 积分累计至等值十元后可申请提现，转入支付宝或微信账户；
en: Once your points reach the equivalent of fifty yuan you can request a payout to Alipay or WeChat;

zh: 委托方会限定样本条件，包括年龄段、城市、职业或特定产品的使用频率。名额满额或条件不符时，
en: Clients set sample criteria such as age bracket, city, occupation or how often you use a particular product. When quotas fill up or you do not match,

zh: 余额以整数最小单位记账，展示时省略小数末尾的零，因此显示的数值与实际记账完全一致。
en: Balances are recorded in the smallest whole unit and trailing zeros are dropped on display, so what you see matches the ledger exactly.

zh: 法币榜统计当前可用余额，提现后排名会下降；等级由经验累计决定，经验只来自通过核验的问卷。
en: The cash board ranks by available balance, so it drops after a payout. Level comes from accumulated experience, and experience only comes from verified surveys.

zh: 常见原因是收款账户与注册人实名信息不一致、账号未完成基础资料，
en: Common causes are a payout account whose real-name details do not match the registrant, or an account that has not completed its basic profile,

zh: 这份政策说明Chengfa（以下称「本站」）在你注册和参与调研的过程中会碰到哪些信息、为什么需要它们、
en: This policy explains what information Chengfa (the site) encounters while you register and take part in research, why we need it,

zh: 本站面向 18 周岁以上的用户。市场调研通常对参与者年龄有要求，未满 18 周岁请不要注册；
en: The site is for users aged 18 and over. Market research usually sets age requirements, so please do not register if you are under 18;

zh: 使用邮箱完成注册，耗时约三十秒。填写年龄段、所在城市与职业等基础信息，
en: Register with your email; it takes about thirty seconds. Fill in your age bracket, city and occupation,

zh: 当前没有与你的资料匹配的问卷，或本轮名额已经招满。新问卷上线时，站内消息会发出提醒；
en: No surveys match your profile right now, or this round's quota is already full. We send an in-site message when new surveys go live;

zh: 平台不设邀请码。注册完成后即可浏览全部问卷，积分于答卷审核通过后即时入账；
en: There are no invite codes. Once registered you can browse every survey, and points are credited as soon as a response is approved;

zh: 提现申请提交后金额进入冻结，审核通过十五个工作日内打款；兑换码类商品即时发放，
en: Once you request a payout the amount is frozen, and it is paid within fifteen working days of approval. Code rewards are delivered instantly,

zh: 积分累计至等值十元后即可提交申请。审核通过后十五个工作日内到账，
en: Once your points reach the equivalent of fifty yuan you can submit a request. It arrives within fifteen working days of approval,

zh: 条款调整时会在站内公告并更新顶部日期，重大变更会通过站内消息单独通知。
en: When these terms change we post a site notice and update the date at the top; major changes are also announced by in-site message.

zh: 问卷列表标注题目类型、预计耗时与积分额度。中途退出不计入积分，
en: Every listing shows the question type, the estimated time and the point value. Quitting halfway does not earn points,

zh: ：你参与某份问卷时，问卷商需要知道你是一个独立的、真实的参与者，因此会获得本站生成的参与标识、问卷编号与参与时间。你的邮箱和密码不会提供给他们。
en: : when you take a survey the provider needs to know you are a distinct, real participant, so they receive a participation ID we generate, the survey ID and the participation time. Your email and password are never shared with them.

zh: 不计入积分。问卷按完成状态结算，中途退出视为该份样本作废，委托方亦不会为不完整的答卷付费。
en: no points. Surveys settle on completion; quitting halfway voids that sample, and the client does not pay for an incomplete response either.

zh: 余额是当前可以提现或兑换的部分；冻结是已经提交提现申请、正在审核的部分。
en: Available is what you can withdraw or redeem right now; frozen is the amount already requested and under review.

zh: 委托方获取的是脱敏统计结果与匿名答卷，不包含手机号、邮箱及真实姓名。
en: Clients receive aggregated, de-identified results and anonymous responses. Phone numbers, emails and real names are never included.

zh: 乘法币可提现至支付宝或微信，也可即时兑换数字兑换码。两条路径折算比例一致，
en: XB can be paid out to Alipay or WeChat, or redeemed instantly for digital codes. Both routes use the same conversion rate,

zh: 平台收益来源于委托方支付的调研费用。委托方提出调研需求，平台负责问卷分发与数据回收，
en: The platform earns from research fees paid by clients. A client submits a study, and we handle distribution and data collection,

zh: 账户、余额、问卷与提现的问题都可以在这里提交。附上相关单号，
en: Questions about your account, balance, surveys or payouts can all be submitted here. Include the relevant reference number,

zh: 答卷的具体内容由问卷商的页面直接收集，不经过本站服务器。本站只保存「你参与过这份问卷」这一条记录，用于避免重复参与和后续核对奖励。
en: Response content is collected on the provider's own page and never passes through our servers. We only store the fact that you took part, to prevent repeat participation and to reconcile rewards later.

zh: 墙由第三方托管，在你的账号名下展开任务列表；同一个账号 ID 每次打开都是同一个人，
en: The wall is hosted by a third party and opens the task list under your account; the same account ID is the same person every time,

zh: 每一笔余额变动都先记流水再落余额，可按时间与类型逐笔核对。
en: Every balance change is written to the ledger before it reaches the balance, so you can check each entry by time and type.

zh: 法币为主榜，等级为次榜。法币取决于已完成问卷的结算金额，等级取决于累计经验，
en: Cash is the main board and level the secondary one. Cash reflects the settled value of completed surveys, level reflects accumulated experience,

zh: 公开主页展示乘法币余额、等级、好感度与已完成的提现记录，
en: The public profile shows your XB balance, level, reputation and completed payout history,

zh: 以下情况问卷商可能判定答卷无效，本站会相应撤回奖励：答题时间异常、答案前后矛盾、随意勾选、未通过质量抽查、重复参与同一项目。
en: Providers may invalidate a response, and we then claw back the reward, when: the time taken is abnormal, answers contradict each other, options are picked at random, a quality check fails, or the same study is taken twice.

zh: 经验只来自通过核验的问卷，答卷被判定无效时对应经验一并扣回。
en: Experience only comes from verified surveys; if a response is invalidated, the matching experience is deducted as well.

zh: 注册即表示你已读过并同意以下内容。条款写得直白，重点是三件事：
en: By registering you confirm that you have read and agree to the following. The terms are plain, and three things matter most:

zh: 政策有实质变化时，会在本站公告并通过站内消息通知，同时更新页面顶部的日期。
en: If the policy changes materially we post a site notice, send an in-site message, and update the date at the top of the page.

zh: 积分可自由选择用途。既可按等值金额提现，亦可兑换指定平台的数字兑换码，
en: You can use your points however you like: withdraw the cash equivalent, or redeem them for digital codes on selected platforms,

zh: 每一笔余额变动都先记流水再落余额，可按时间与类型逐笔核对。 出现金额差异时，用单号追溯对应的问卷或提现申请。
en: Every balance change is written to the ledger before it reaches the balance, so you can check each entry by time and type. When an amount looks off, use the reference number to trace the survey or payout behind it.

zh: 账户还没有任何资金变动。
en: No money has moved in this account yet.

zh: 余额以整数最小单位记账，展示时省略小数末尾的零，因此显示的数值与实际记账完全一致。 提现申请提交后，金额从可用余额划入冻结，审核通过才从冻结中扣除。
en: Balances are recorded in the smallest whole unit and trailing zeros are dropped on display, so what you see matches the ledger exactly. When you request a payout the amount moves from available to frozen, and it only leaves frozen once it is approved.

zh: Chengfa收支明细：逐笔查看问卷奖励、提现与兑换记录。
en: Chengfa ledger: every survey reward, payout and redemption, entry by entry.

zh: 法币为主榜，等级为次榜。法币取决于已完成问卷的结算金额，等级取决于累计经验， 两者不互相换算，各有各的榜。
en: Cash is the main board and level the secondary one. Cash reflects the settled value of completed surveys, level reflects accumulated experience. The two never convert into each other; each has its own board.

zh: 封禁与注销账户不计入
en: Banned and closed accounts are excluded
The board is empty for now.

zh: 法币榜统计当前可用余额，提现后排名会下降；等级由经验累计决定，经验只来自通过核验的问卷。 榜单只展示公开信息，点击用户名可查看对方的公开主页。
en: The cash board ranks by available balance, so it drops after a payout; level comes from accumulated experience, and experience only comes from verified surveys. The board only shows public information; click a username to open that person's public profile.

zh: Chengfa天梯榜：按乘法币与等级排序的公开榜单。
en: Chengfa leaderboard: a public ranking by XB balance and level.

zh: 兑换发货、提现审核结果与系统通知都会发到这里，点击任意一条可以展开全文并标记已读。
en: Redemption deliveries, payout review results and system notices all arrive here. Click any message to read it in full and mark it as read.

zh: Chengfa站内消息：兑换发货、提现审核与系统通知。
en: Chengfa messages: redemption deliveries, payout reviews and system notices.

zh: Chengfa的站点公告：规则调整、维护安排与活动通知。
en: Chengfa site notices: rule changes, maintenance windows and announcements.
Pick one and get credited when done

zh: 这页不是第三方网站，是本站照着广告墙的样子做的模拟版。点「标记完成」， 浏览器会请求本站接口，接口再按真实回调的那套逻辑入账——所以走的是和正式接入完全相同的代码路径。
en: This page is not a third-party site. It is our own mock-up of an ad wall. Clicking 'Mark complete' makes the browser call our API, which then credits the reward with exactly the same logic as a real callback, so it exercises the same code path as a live integration.

zh: · 每一笔都会生成独立的交易号
en: · every entry gets its own transaction ID
Back to Earn to see the record

zh: 站内模拟的广告墙，用于在没有接入真实服务商前验证回调入账链路。
en: An in-site mock ad wall, used to verify the callback crediting path before a real provider is connected.

zh: 账户、余额、问卷与提现的问题都可以在这里提交。附上相关单号， 处理会快很多；涉及资金的争议请在描述中写明金额与时间。
en: Questions about your account, balance, surveys or payouts can all be submitted here. Include the relevant reference number to speed things up; for money disputes, state the amount and the time in your description.

zh: 提交时自动记录账户，便于核对身份。
en: Your account is recorded automatically so we can verify who you are.

zh: 提交后可在「我的工单」查看处理进度。
en: After submitting, track progress under My tickets.

zh: 正文附截图或单号，并写明账户 UID，处理时不用再来回确认身份。
en: Attach a screenshot or reference number and include your account UID so we do not have to come back and confirm your identity.

zh: 已提交的工单与处理进度在账户设置的工单区块查看。
en: Submitted tickets and their progress live in the tickets section of account settings.

zh: 一般 24 小时内，资金争议 3 个工作日内
en: Usually within 24 hours; money disputes within 3 business days

zh: 账户、余额、问卷、提现、举报
问卷为什么一份都看不到？
en: Why can I not see a single survey?

zh: 常见原因有三种：问卷按样本条件投放，资料缺项或不符合条件的账户不会匹配到； 本轮名额已招满；或该问卷你已经参与过。补全账户资料后，可匹配的问卷会增加。
en: There are three common reasons: studies are targeted by sample criteria, so accounts with missing or ineligible details never match; this round's quota is already full; or you have already taken that survey. Completing your profile increases the number of surveys you match.

zh: 余额和冻结金额有什么区别？
en: What is the difference between available and frozen?

zh: 余额是当前可以提现或兑换的部分；冻结是已经提交提现申请、正在审核的部分。 审核通过后从冻结中扣除，驳回则原路退回余额。
en: Available is what you can withdraw or redeem right now; frozen is the amount already requested and under review. On approval it is deducted from frozen; if rejected it returns to available.

zh: 常见原因是收款账户与注册人实名信息不一致、账号未完成基础资料， 或同一账户短时间内多次提交。驳回后金额立即退回，可修正信息后重新提交。
en: Common causes are a payout account whose real-name details do not match the registrant, an account with an incomplete profile, or repeated requests in a short window. The amount returns immediately after a rejection, and you can fix the details and resubmit.

zh: 等级怎么升？经验从哪里来？
en: How do I level up, and where does experience come from?

zh: 经验只来自通过核验的问卷，答卷被判定无效时对应经验一并扣回。 等级不设人工调整通道，也不出售经验。
en: Experience only comes from verified surveys, and if a response is invalidated the matching experience is deducted. Levels cannot be adjusted by hand and experience is never sold.

zh: 别人能看到我的余额吗？
en: Can other people see my balance?

zh: 公开主页展示乘法币余额、等级、好感度与已完成的提现记录， 不展示邮箱、IP、登录记录与提现账户信息。
en: The public profile shows your XB balance, level, reputation and completed payout history. It never shows your email, IP, sign-in history or payout account details.

zh: 发生了什么、什么时候发生、涉及多少金额或哪个单号。
en: What happened, when it happened, how much money was involved, or which reference number.

zh: Chengfa客服：账户、余额、问卷相关问题的反馈渠道。
en: Chengfa support: a channel for questions about accounts, balances and surveys.

zh: 注册于 — · 已加入 1 天
该账户还没有成功的提现记录。
en: This account has no completed payouts yet.

zh: UID 可能写错了，或者该账户已经注销。
en: The UID may be mistyped, or the account has been closed.
The public profile of a Chengfa user.

zh: 暂无兑换记录。兑换成功后，条目与兑换码会出现在这里。
en: No redemptions yet. Once a redemption succeeds, the entry and its code appear here.

zh: 用于登录与找回密码。更换后需要在新邮箱完成一次验证。
en: Used to sign in and to recover your password. After a change you must verify the new address.

zh: 建议与其他站点使用不同密码，怀疑泄露时立即更换。
en: Use a password you do not use elsewhere, and change it as soon as you suspect a leak.

zh: 尚无问卷商回传风控数据。
en: No risk data reported by providers yet.

zh: 还没有工单。账户、余额、提现或问卷审核的问题都可以在这里提，回复会同时发到站内消息。
en: No tickets yet. Account, balance, payout or survey review questions can all be raised here, and replies also arrive as in-site messages.

zh: 回复会同时发到站内消息，可在上方列表查看处理进度。
en: Replies also arrive as in-site messages; track progress in the list above.

zh: 用户端 11 项 · 点「展开」看键位
en: 11 user items · expand to see the keys

zh: 点「改键」后按任意数字或字母即可绑定；撞键会自动交换。` 键固定回首页，不参与改键。键位只存在这台电脑的浏览器里。
en: Click Rebind and press any number or letter to assign it; clashes swap automatically. The ` key always returns home and cannot be rebound. Bindings live only in this browser.

zh: 一键换掉整站主色，其余颜色保持协调。后台默认本来就是蓝的。
en: Swap the site's main colour in one click; everything else stays in harmony. The admin area is blue by default.

zh: 再获得 40 点经验升至 LV4
正文用墨色，说明与编号用次要灰，分隔线由墨色调淡。这里是示例，改动会即时反映在这扇小窗里。
en: Body text uses ink, captions and labels use muted grey, and hairlines are a lightened ink. This is a sample; changes show up in this card immediately.

zh: 颜色存在本机 cookie 里，换设备不带走。点「确定生效」后整站立即换色，恢复默认随时可以。
en: Colours are stored in a cookie on this device and do not follow you elsewhere. Click Apply and the whole site changes instantly; reset to the default at any time.

zh: Chengfa账户设置。查看身份、余额、安全与偏好。
en: Chengfa account settings: identity, balance, security and preferences.

zh: 这份政策说明Chengfa（以下称「本站」）在你注册和参与调研的过程中会碰到哪些信息、为什么需要它们、 以及会不会给别人。写的是实际发生的事，不是模板套话。
en: This policy explains what information Chengfa (the site) encounters while you register and take part in research, why we need it, and whether we ever hand it to anyone else. It describes what actually happens, not boilerplate.

zh: 本站是一个市场调研的参与入口。你在这里注册账户、从问卷大厅选取开放的调研项目、完成问卷后累计奖励， 奖励可用于提现或兑换数字权益。问卷本身由第三方调研机构（以下称「问卷商」）提供和运营，本站负责把入口、 身份与结算管好。
en: This site is an entry point for market research. You register an account, pick open studies from the survey hall, and accumulate rewards as you complete them; rewards can be withdrawn or redeemed for digital benefits. The surveys themselves are provided and run by third-party research firms (providers). We take care of the gateway, identity and settlement.

zh: 邮箱地址：作为登录凭据，也是找回账户的唯一途径。
en: Email address: your sign-in credential and the only way to recover your account.

zh: 用户名：站内显示用，可以随时在设置页修改。
en: Username: shown across the site and changeable in settings at any time.

en: Account frozen: surveys, redemption and withdrawal are suspended. You can submit a ticket to explain your situation.

zh: 乘法 · 问卷积分平台
乘法是一个问卷积分平台。用户注册后可参与市场调研问卷，按完成情况获取积分，积分支持提现至支付宝或微信，亦可兑换数字兑换码。
en: Chengfa is a survey rewards platform. Register to take market research surveys, earn points based on completion, cash out to Alipay or WeChat, or redeem digital codes.

zh: 单份问卷平均收益 100 分

积分累计至等值五十元后可申请提现，转入支付宝或微信账户；
          亦可直接兑换 Steam 充值卡、游戏激活码及软件会员等数字兑换码，到账速度快于现金提现。
en: Once your points reach the equivalent of 50 CNY you can request a payout to Alipay or WeChat, or spend them directly on digital codes — Steam wallet cards, game keys, software subscriptions — which arrive faster than a cash payout.

zh:
积分累计至等值五十元后即可提交申请。审核通过后十五个工作日内到账，
          处理记录可在「积分明细」中查询。提现账户须与注册人实名信息一致。
en: You can apply once your points reach the equivalent of 50 CNY. Approved payouts arrive within fifteen business days, and the record appears in your ledger. The receiving account must match your registered identity.

zh:
提供 Steam 充值卡、游戏激活码及常用软件年费会员。兑换申请经审核后处理，
          进度可在「积分明细」中查询。
en: Steam wallet cards, game keys and annual software subscriptions. Codes are processed after review; the status appears in your ledger.

zh: 发放 · 进度可在明细查询
问卷来自真实的研究需求。你花几分钟作答，样本就算进去了。
en: Every survey comes from a real research need. A few minutes of your time becomes part of the sample.

zh:
可以。积分对应委托方已支付的调研费用，并非平台自行发行。五十元提现门槛的设置原因在于，
          低于该金额的转账手续费与金额本身接近，对双方均不经济。每笔积分的来源、对应问卷与发放时间，
          均可在「积分明细」中查询。
en: Yes. Points represent research fees the client has already paid, not currency the platform issues. The 50 CNY payout minimum exists because below that amount the transfer fee approaches the sum itself, which is uneconomic for both sides. Every point's origin, source survey and payout time is listed in the ledger.

zh:
提现申请提交后金额进入冻结，审核通过后十五个工作日内打款；兑换码类商品即时发放，
        订阅类商品由人工在两个工作日内开通，结果通过站内消息通知。
en: Once a payout is requested, the amount is held until it is approved, then paid out within fifteen business days. Gift codes are issued instantly; subscriptions are activated manually within two business days, and you are notified by in-site message.
